title_zh: 曝苹果进军智能家居，拟于 10 月 13 日推出家庭中枢
content_zh:
据彭博社 Mark Gurman 9 月 30 日报道，苹果计划于 10 月 13 日推出智能家居产品线，核心是代号 J490 的家庭控制中枢，同时更新 HomePod mini 和 Apple TV。新品将用于展示新版 Siri AI 的能力，苹果对此拒绝置评。

家庭中枢据报配备约 6 英寸方形屏幕，可放置在台面；另一款代号 J491 的版本用于壁挂。设备通过声音或面部识别不同家庭成员，自动显示对应的联系人、消息、日历与应用布局，访客模式会隐藏个人信息。面部识别的可靠性低于 iPhone 的 Face ID，用户可要求通过 iPhone 进行二次认证，识别失败时也可由手机辅助。

中枢支持控制温控器、门锁等联网设备，还可用于 FaceTime、室内对讲、音乐播放及 iCloud 照片展示。设备没有电池，需要持续接入 USB-C 电源；桌面版本的屏幕可手动前后倾斜，底座内置麦克风与扬声器。

HomePod mini 与 Apple TV 将延续现有外观，换用更快的处理器以支持 Siri AI 模型。HomePod mini 据报新增绿色、粉色。苹果还在开发配备更大屏幕和机械臂的升级中枢，但该产品不属于此次计划发布的首批设备。

🔗 相关阅读：突发！苹果全新产品线曝光，Siri AI 进家门
title_en: Apple to Enter Smart Home Market with October 13 Launch of AI-Powered Home Hub
content_en:
Apple is set to venture deeper into the smart home market with the planned launch of a new product line on October 13, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The lineup will feature a smart home control hub (codename J490), alongside updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV, all designed to showcase the capabilities of Apple's new Siri AI.

The upcoming home hub features a 6-inch square screen, with a tabletop version (J490) and a wall-mounted version (J491). The device utilizes voice and facial recognition to identify different family members, automatically customizing contacts, messages, calendars, and app layouts, while offering a guest mode to protect privacy. It acts as a central controller for smart home devices like thermostats and smart locks, and supports FaceTime, intercom functions, music playback, and iCloud photo displays. The device lacks a built-in battery and must be powered continuously via USB-C.

Meanwhile, the updated HomePod mini and Apple TV will retain their current designs but will be equipped with faster processors to support the new Siri AI models. Apple is also reportedly developing a premium hub featuring a larger screen and a robotic arm, though this advanced model is not part of the initial October release.

title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 中国首销 3 天销量超上代首周，苹果周份额达 33%
content_zh:
Counterpoint Research 9 月 30 日公布中国智能手机周度追踪数据：iPhone 18 Pro 系列于 9 月 18 日开售，上市首 3 天销量比 iPhone 17 Pro 系列上市首周高 12%。这两个比较时段长度不同，不能理解为两个完整首周的同比。苹果在 9 月 14 日至 20 日的第 38 周登上中国市场周销量榜首，份额为 33%。

Counterpoint 高级分析师 Ivan Lam 认为，iPhone 18 基础版延后上市，可能使部分消费者转向 Pro 系列；部分中国品牌旗舰机型涨价，也缩小了它们与 iPhone Pro 系列的价格差距。该机构同时指出，国内手机周销量自 7 月起持续同比双位数下降，9 月新品陆续上市，机构预计市场有机会环比恢复。
title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Sales Surge in China, Driving Apple to 33% Weekly Market Share
content_en:
The iPhone 18 Pro series has seen a strong debut in China. According to Counterpoint Research, sales of the iPhone 18 Pro series during its first three days of release (starting September 18) surpassed the entire first-week sales of the previous iPhone 17 Pro series by 12%. Driven by this strong demand, Apple secured the top spot in China's smartphone market for the 38th week of the year (September 14–20), capturing a 33% market share.

Counterpoint Senior Analyst Ivan Lam noted that the delayed release of the base iPhone 18 model likely nudged some consumers toward the Pro series. Additionally, price increases for several domestic flagship models have narrowed the price gap with Apple's Pro lineup, making the iPhone 18 Pro more competitive.

While China's overall weekly smartphone sales have experienced double-digit year-on-year declines since July, the influx of new product launches in September is expected to drive a month-on-month market recovery.

title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon，先向网络防御者开放测试
content_zh:
Google 9 月 30 日发布新一代旗舰模型 Gemini 4 Argon，首批通过 Fairwind 计划向受信任的网络防御者开放，后续将逐步扩展至开发者、企业和消费者，付费 API 客户及 Google AI Ultra 订阅者优先。

Argon 面向软件工程、法律与金融等专业任务，以及网络安全防御。谷歌将其输出上限从此前的 6.4 万 token 提高到 100 万 token，支持更长的推理与任务执行。

Google 称，内部工程师已用它调试代码、迁移大型代码库及设计算法；在真实长任务软件工程测试 DeepSWE v1.1 中，模型得分为 77.9%。

不过，据彭博社援引知情人士的说法，Argon 在各类基准测试中表现突出，但在真实业务代码中频频受阻，尤其是决定 App 外观和交互的前端设计。

部分员工认为 Anthropic 的 Fable 和 OpenAI 的 Astra 进步更快，也有员工认为新版本已追上头部实验室。

Google 发言人回应称，「Gemini 4 在编程等领域表现不佳」的说法并不准确。DeepMind 负责人 Koray Kavukcuoglu 此前表示，Google 将永远站在最前沿。

API 上线后的初期价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元，缓存输入比普通输入便宜 95%；优惠期结束后，输入和输出价格分别为 4 美元、20 美元。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，Gemini 4 正式发布，追平 GPT-6 但被质疑「刷榜」，官方辟谣
title_en: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon with 1-Million Token Output for Cybersecurity and Coding
content_en:
Google has officially launched its next-generation flagship AI model, Gemini 4 Argon. The model is initially being rolled out to trusted cybersecurity defenders through the Fairwind program, with plans to expand access to developers, enterprises, and consumers. Paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers will receive priority access.

Tailored for specialized tasks in software engineering, legal, finance, and cybersecurity, Gemini 4 Argon boasts a massive output limit upgrade from 64,000 tokens to 1 million tokens, enabling longer reasoning and complex task execution. Google reports that its internal engineers have already used the model for debugging, migrating large codebases, and designing algorithms. It scored 77.9% on the DeepSWE v1.1 software engineering benchmark.

Despite these achievements, reports suggest the model has faced hurdles with real-world business code, particularly in frontend design. Some Google employees reportedly worry that rivals like Anthropic's Fable and OpenAI's Astra are advancing faster, though others believe Google has caught up. Google has dismissed claims of poor coding performance as inaccurate.

Upon API launch, promotional pricing will be set at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens (with cached inputs discounted by 95%). Standard pricing will later adjust to $4 and $20, respectively.

title_zh: 机构预计 iPhone Duo 年内销量约 600 万部
content_zh:
彭博社 9 月 30 日报道，Counterpoint 首次给出苹果折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 的销量预测：2026 年预计售出约 600 万部。该机预计于 10 月上市，留给今年销售的时间只有一个季度。

Counterpoint 分析师 Ivan Lam 表示，实际销量取决于苹果提升产量的速度。报道将生产进度列为关键变量，因此这一数字是机构预测，尚非苹果订单或实际出货量。

IDC 预计，今年全球折叠屏手机出货量将达到 2290 万部，同比增长约 13%；该机构称，若没有 iPhone Duo 入市，今年这一市场原本可能下滑。两家机构的估算分别针对苹果新机和整个折叠屏品类，不能直接当作同一口径的市场份额计算。
title_en: Counterpoint Forecasts 6 Million iPhone Duo Sales for 2026 Launch Year
content_en:
Research firm Counterpoint has released its first sales forecast for Apple's rumored foldable phone, the "iPhone Duo," projecting sales of approximately 6 million units in 2026, Bloomberg reported on September 30. The device is expected to hit the market in October, leaving only one quarter of sales for the launch year.

Ivan Lam, an analyst at Counterpoint, noted that actual sales will heavily depend on how quickly Apple can ramp up production. Since production speed remains a critical variable, this figure represents an institutional projection rather than actual Apple orders or shipments.

Meanwhile, market research firm IDC estimates that global foldable smartphone shipments will reach 22.9 million units this year, representing a 13% year-on-year growth. IDC highlighted that without the entry of the iPhone Duo, the foldable market might have experienced a decline.

title_zh: DeepSeek 开源昇腾平台基础组件，覆盖算子、计算与跨卡通信
content_zh:
DeepSeek 9 月 30 日宣布，开源面向华为昇腾算力平台的基础设施组件，包括 TileLang 高级语言编译工具、计算库和分布式通信库。这批组件对应其此前在英伟达平台使用的工具，供开发者在昇腾平台编写算子、完成矩阵计算和跨设备通信。

DeepSeek 称，TileLang 昇腾版本封装了 Ascend C 底层指令；其训练中使用的 TileLang 算子，已在昇腾平台有对应实现。同期开放的 DeepGEMM、DeepEP、TileKernels、FlashMLA 和 DeepSelect，分别覆盖矩阵运算、跨设备通信、常规向量与访存、稀疏注意力和数据筛选。

DeepSeek 还披露，华为团队参与了昇腾平台上的计算和通信优化，双方正推进基于昇腾 950 的 128 卡超节点方案。
title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Infrastructure Components for Huawei Ascend Platform
content_en:
AI startup DeepSeek announced on September 30 that it has open-sourced a suite of infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend computing platform. The release includes the TileLang high-level compiler, computation libraries, and distributed communication libraries, mirroring tools DeepSeek previously used on Nvidia platforms. These components will allow developers to write operators, perform matrix calculations, and manage cross-device communication on Ascend hardware.

According to DeepSeek, the Ascend version of TileLang encapsulates low-level Ascend C instructions, with operators used in DeepSeek's own training now fully supported on the platform. Other open-sourced tools include DeepGEMM for matrix operations, DeepEP for cross-device communication, TileKernels for standard vector and memory access, FlashMLA for sparse attention, and DeepSelect for data filtering.

DeepSeek also revealed that Huawei's engineering team participated in optimizing computation and communication on the Ascend platform. The two companies are currently co-developing a 128-card supernode solution powered by the Ascend 950 processor.

title_zh: Anthropic IPO 材料曝光，近半收入来自亚马逊与Google 云渠道
content_zh:
据路透社 9 月 29 日报道，Anthropic 为 IPO 准备的申报材料显示，2025 年约 47% 的收入来自亚马逊和谷歌的云市场渠道。两家公司同时是 Anthropic 的投资者、算力供应商，也是拥有自研 AI 产品的竞争者。

报道称，Anthropic 2025 年收入接近 46 亿美元，经营亏损超过 80 亿美元。通过上述云渠道销售的合同，Anthropic 按总额确认收入，将向合作伙伴支付的分销费用计入销售、营销与合作伙伴支出；这部分费用约为 3.51 亿美元。Anthropic 表示，自己是相关交易的主要责任方，该处理方式遵循既定会计原则。

云市场渠道占收入的比例，已从 2023 年的 11%、2024 年的 32% 升至 2025 年的 47%。渠道能让 Anthropic 接触云服务商的既有客户，但申报材料也提示：合作伙伴了解其定价及客户信息，双方关系变化可能影响业务。路透还称，2025 年两名未具名客户各贡献 12% 的收入，许多大客户没有长期合同约束，可减少或停止支出。
title_en: Anthropic IPO Filings Reveal Heavy Reliance on Amazon and Google Cloud Channels
content_en:
Anthropic's IPO preparation materials reveal that approximately 47% of its projected 2025 revenue is generated through Amazon and Google's cloud marketplace channels, Reuters reported on September 29. Both tech giants serve as Anthropic's investors and computing power providers, while simultaneously competing with their own in-house AI products.

The filings show that Anthropic's 2025 revenue is approaching $4.6 billion, alongside an operating loss of over $8 billion. For sales made through these cloud marketplaces, Anthropic recognizes revenue on a gross basis, categorizing the roughly $351 million in distribution fees paid to partners under sales, marketing, and partnership expenses. The company stated that this treatment complies with established accounting principles as it remains the primary obligor in these transactions.

The share of revenue coming from cloud marketplace channels has surged rapidly, rising from 11% in 2023 to 32% in 2024, and reaching 47% in 2025. While these channels grant Anthropic access to the cloud providers' established customer bases, the filings warn of potential risks: partners have visibility into Anthropic's pricing and customer data, and any shift in these relationships could harm business. Additionally, two unnamed clients accounted for 12% of revenue each in 2025, and many major customers are not bound by long-term contracts, leaving them free to reduce or halt spending.

title_zh: 集邦：第四季度 DRAM 合约价预计再涨 10%—15%，消费端仍承压
content_zh:
集邦咨询 9 月 30 日发布存储器市场研究，预计今年第四季度一般型 DRAM 合约价环比上涨 10%—15%，NAND Flash 合约价上涨 15%—20%。存储器厂商持续把先进制程和产能转向服务器应用，消费电子需求偏弱，仍面临供应和成本压力。

报告指出，手机品牌的低价库存逐步用尽，移动 DRAM 配额依然吃紧；部分 PC 品牌为降低整机成本，开始调低主流机型的 SSD 容量。笔电厂商同时担心 2027 年 DRAM 供应进一步收紧，维持积极采购。

企业级 SSD 是报告中唯一预计第四季度涨幅扩大的品类。云服务商加码 AI 推理基础设施，智能体带来的实时检索与缓存需求推动高容量 QLC SSD 采购，而新增供应多已被提前锁定。上述涨幅均为集邦对元件合约市场的预测，并非手机、电脑或零售硬盘的统一涨价幅度。
title_en: TrendForce: Q4 DRAM Contract Prices Projected to Rise 10%–15% Amid Consumer Market Pressures
content_en:
According to a market research report released by TrendForce on September 30, contract prices for standard DRAM are projected to rise by 10% to 15% quarter-on-quarter in the fourth quarter of this year, while NAND Flash contract prices are expected to increase by 15% to 20%. Memory manufacturers continue to shift advanced process nodes and capacity toward server applications, leaving the consumer electronics sector under pressure from weak demand, tight supply, and rising costs.

The report highlights that mobile DRAM supply remains tight as smartphone brands deplete their low-priced inventory. To mitigate overall hardware costs, some PC brands have begun reducing SSD capacities in mainstream models. Meanwhile, laptop manufacturers are maintaining active procurement due to concerns over further DRAM supply tightening by 2027.

Enterprise SSDs represent the only category projected to see an accelerating price hike in Q4. This trend is driven by cloud service providers expanding their AI inference infrastructure, where real-time retrieval and caching demands from AI agents are fueling the procurement of high-capacity QLC SSDs. Much of this new supply has already been locked in advance. TrendForce notes that these projections reflect component contract markets and do not represent uniform retail price hikes for consumer devices.

title_zh: 快手成立「企业 AI 生产力」组织，于越转任可灵 CEO
content_zh:
快手 9 月 30 日宣布成立跨事业部虚拟组织「企业 AI 生产力」，统一建设通用 Agent、企业上下文体系与内部信息系统。该组织由智能办公平台部和 AI 生产力中心组成，由智能办公平台部负责人王诩牵头。

据每日经济新闻报道，新组织既负责基础办公系统稳定运行，也统筹 AI 基础设施，打通数据与系统之间的壁垒。快手此前已推出通用生产力智能体 MyFlicker、数据分析智能体 Data Agent 等内部工具；截至今年 6 月，使用各类自研 AI Agent 的员工占比超过 92%，研发技术人员的 AI 代码贡献率达到 60%。这些比例来自公司披露。

同日，快手调整可灵 AI 的管理分工：创始人兼 CEO 程一笑将兼任社区科学线负责人，原负责人于越转任可灵 AI 公司董事兼 CEO，专注于可灵 AI 的经营管理。程一笑在全员信中表示，可灵仍是快手 AI 战略的核心布局，将继续与其他业务协同。
title_en: Kuaishou Establishes "Enterprise AI Productivity" Unit; Yu Yue Appointed CEO of Kling AI
content_en:
Kuaishou announced on September 30 the establishment of a cross-departmental virtual organization named "Enterprise AI Productivity." The new unit aims to unify the development of general AI agents, enterprise context systems, and internal information systems. Comprising the Smart Office Platform Department and the AI Productivity Center, the organization will be led by Wang Xu, head of the Smart Office Platform Department.

The new unit is tasked with ensuring the stable operation of basic office systems while coordinating AI infrastructure to break down barriers between data and systems. Kuaishou has already deployed several internal tools, including the general productivity agent MyFlicker and the Data Agent. According to company disclosures, as of June this year, over 92% of Kuaishou employees utilized self-developed AI agents, and AI-generated code accounted for 60% of the total code contributed by R&D staff.

On the same day, Kuaishou adjusted the management structure of its video-generation tool, Kling AI. Kuaishou founder and CEO Cheng Yixiao will concurrently head the Community Science line, while the former head, Yu Yue, will transition to serve as Director and CEO of Kling AI to focus on its business operations. Cheng reiterated in an internal letter that Kling AI remains a core component of Kuaishou's AI strategy and will continue to collaborate closely with other business units.

title_zh: 江淮确认与华为、Stellantis 沟洽合作
content_zh:
江淮汽车 9 月 30 日晚公告，确认公司与华为、Stellantis 三方确有沟洽合作意向，但合作内容、合作形式均未确定，也未签署任何有约束力的正式协议。公司提醒，后续合作推进仍存在较大不确定性。

此前有媒体报道，玛莎拉蒂电动车型或采用鸿蒙智行平台。江淮此次确认的是三方接洽意向，公告没有确认具体品牌、车型或投产时间。

公司在 9 月 28 日至 30 日连续三个交易日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过 20%，因此披露股票交易异常波动公告。江淮工作人员向每日经济新闻表示，公司生产经营正常，没有应披露而未披露的信息。
title_en: JAC Motors Confirms Preliminary Talks with Huawei and Stellantis
content_en:
JAC Motors announced on the evening of September 30 that it has held preliminary discussions with Huawei and Stellantis regarding potential cooperation. However, the company emphasized that the scope and format of the partnership have not been determined, no binding agreements have been signed, and significant uncertainties remain regarding future progress.

The announcement follows media reports suggesting that Maserati's electric vehicles might adopt Huawei's Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance (HIMA) platform. JAC Motors clarified that the current discussions are preliminary and did not confirm any specific brands, models, or production schedules.

The disclosure was triggered by an abnormal stock price fluctuation, with JAC's shares deviating by more than 20% over three consecutive trading days from September 28 to 30. A company representative stated that operations remain normal and there is no undisclosed material information.

title_zh: FTC 调查 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 公司，关注失控智能体的消费者风险
content_zh:
路透社 9 月 30 日援引美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）高级官员称，该机构已对 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 实验室展开行业范围调查，审查 AI 智能体可能给消费者造成的伤害。

调查计划包括向企业正式索取信息、要求高管作证，也涉及评估前沿模型能力的研究机构 METR。此前，AI 智能体未经授权访问系统、侵入外部服务器等事件引发安全争议。

FTC 主席 Andrew Ferguson 上周表示，开发者需要测试模型的网络安全风险，若智能体造成伤害，应承担相应责任。本次调查仍处于取证阶段，尚非对上述企业作出的违法认定。
title_en: FTC Launches Probe Into OpenAI and Anthropic Over Risks of Rogue AI Agents
content_en:
The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) has initiated an industry-wide investigation into leading artificial intelligence laboratories, including OpenAI and Anthropic, to examine potential consumer harms posed by autonomous AI agents.

The probe will involve formal requests for information, executive testimonies, and evaluations from METR, a research organization focused on assessing frontier model capabilities. The inquiry follows recent safety controversies where AI agents reportedly accessed unauthorized systems and breached external servers.

FTC Commissioner Andrew Ferguson emphasized that developers must rigorously test their models for cybersecurity risks and should be held accountable if their AI agents cause harm. The FTC noted that the investigation is currently in the fact-finding stage and does not constitute a formal finding of any legal violations.

title_zh: 美光全年营收达 1331.88 亿美元，预计下一季营收 615 亿美元
content_zh:
美光 9 月 30 日公布截至 9 月 3 日的 2026 财年及第四财季业绩。全年营收为 1331.88 亿美元，上一财年为 373.78 亿美元；按美国通用会计准则（GAAP）计算，全年净利润为 849.69 亿美元。

第四财季营收达到 542.29 亿美元，上一季度为 414.56 亿美元，去年同期为 113.15 亿美元。该季度 GAAP 净利润为 377.01 亿美元，经调整净利润为 383.98 亿美元；经调整摊薄每股收益为 33.42 美元。

分业务看，云内存业务营收为 162.83 亿美元，核心数据中心业务营收为 180.02 亿美元。第四财季 GAAP 毛利率升至 86.8%，经调整自由现金流为 332 亿美元。

美光预计 2027 财年第一季度营收为 615 亿美元，上下浮动 15 亿美元。CEO Sanjay Mehrotra 表示，公司将增加技术、产品和制造投资，长期客户协议也增强了其对经营表现持续性的信心。
title_en: Micron Reports Blockbuster FY2026 Earnings, Forecasts $61.5 Billion for Q1
content_en:
Micron Technology has announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026, showcasing explosive growth. The semiconductor giant reported full-year revenue of $133.19 billion, a massive leap from $37.38 billion in the previous fiscal year. Full-year GAAP net income reached $84.97 billion.

For the fourth quarter, Micron's revenue surged to $54.23 billion, up from $41.46 billion in the prior quarter and $11.32 billion in the same period last year. The company posted a Q4 GAAP net income of $37.70 billion, with an adjusted diluted EPS of $33.42. Key drivers included its cloud memory business, which generated $16.28 billion, and its core data center business, which brought in $18.00 billion.

Looking ahead, Micron projects first-quarter revenue for fiscal 2027 to be approximately $61.5 billion (plus or minus $1.5 billion). CEO Sanjay Mehrotra expressed strong confidence in the company's sustained performance, citing plans to boost investments in technology, products, and manufacturing, alongside long-term customer commitments.

title_zh: 派拉蒙获准完成华纳收购，美泰 CEO 将任合并公司联席 CEO
content_zh:
据美联社报道，美国联邦法官 9 月 30 日批准派拉蒙与 12 个州就收购华纳兄弟探索达成的和解协议，为交易完成扫清了这起反垄断诉讼障碍。派拉蒙此前表示，希望最快在 10 月初完成收购。

同日，派拉蒙宣布聘请美泰董事长兼 CEO Ynon Kreiz。他将于 10 月 5 日加入派拉蒙，并在并购完成后担任合并公司的联席 CEO、加入董事会。David Ellison 将继续担任董事长兼 CEO，双方共同管理合并业务。

两人的分工已在公告中明确：Ellison 负责长期战略、创意方向、人才关系、技术及资本配置，Kreiz 负责日常运营和业务整合。Kreiz 自 2018 年起执掌美泰，推动旗下玩具品牌向电影、电视、游戏和消费产品延伸，美泰首部院线电影《芭比》由华纳发行。

各州最初主张阻止合并，认为交易会削弱竞争、减少观众选择。和解包含增加美国电影制作、支持受并购影响员工及建立新闻编辑监督等承诺。法庭批准和解后，反对并购的团体仍认为这些措施不足。
title_en: Paramount Cleared to Complete Warner Acquisition; Mattel CEO Named Co-CEO
content_en:
A U.S. federal judge has approved a settlement between Paramount and 12 states, clearing a major antitrust hurdle for Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. Paramount aims to finalize the transaction as early as October.

In tandem with the clearance, Paramount announced that Mattel Chairman and CEO Ynon Kreiz will join the company on October 5. Following the merger, Kreiz will serve as co-CEO and board member of the combined entity, working alongside David Ellison, who will remain Chairman and CEO.

Under the leadership structure, Ellison will oversee long-term strategy, creative direction, talent relations, technology, and capital allocation. Kreiz, who has led Mattel since 2018 and successfully expanded its toy brands into blockbuster entertainment like *Barbie*, will manage day-to-day operations and business integration. The settlement also includes commitments to boost U.S. film production and support employees affected by the merger.

title_zh: Reddit 将于 11 月停止 RSS，明年 3 月关闭公共 API
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 9 月 30 日报道，Reddit 宣布将于 11 月 13 日停止支持 RSS，并于 2027 年 3 月关闭公共 API。公司称，RSS 已成为大规模抓取和自动化滥用的常见入口，因而决定停止这项服务。

RSS 让用户能在阅读器中订阅社区更新，也被版主用于提醒和管理。Reddit 建议依赖 RSS 的版主改用 Discord Relay 应用，并在停止支持前迁移工作流程；该替代工具不覆盖社区之外的 RSS 订阅用途。

公共 API 的关闭还会影响用程序访问 Reddit 讨论的工具。获批的第三方应用和机器人开发者需在 2027 年 1 月 12 日前登记，否则将失去 API 访问权限。Reddit 也将限制 Old Reddit 的访问，在未来几个月内，仅允许版主及过去 6 个月使用过该界面的已登录用户继续访问。
title_en: Reddit to Deprecate RSS in November and Shut Down Public API by 2027
content_en:
Reddit will end support for RSS on November 13, 2024, and shut down its public API in March 2027, according to a TechCrunch report. The company cited widespread scraping and automation abuse via RSS as the primary reasons for the decision.

For moderators who rely on RSS for community alerts and management, Reddit recommends transitioning to the Discord Relay app before the shutdown. However, this alternative will not cover RSS subscriptions outside of community management.

The upcoming public API shutdown will further restrict tools used to access Reddit discussions. Approved third-party developers and bot creators must register by January 12, 2027, to retain access. Additionally, Reddit plans to limit access to "Old Reddit" in the coming months, restricting it to moderators and logged-in users who have active history with the interface over the past six months.

title_zh: 💡 汤姆·克鲁斯：观众想要真实的东西和真实的体验
content_zh:
在《Digger》于美国电影学院博物馆举行的映后对话中，汤姆·克鲁斯把自己继续拍电影的动力归结为两件事：不断挑战已有的成功，以及和制作团队一起创造真实体验。《好莱坞报道者》9 月 30 日刊出了现场对谈报道。

克鲁斯说，自己从年轻时就已获得成功，这让他有机会学习更多技能，再寻找运用这些技能的新挑战。在《碟中谍》系列里，他不断增加动作表演的难度；这次出演一位因环境灾难而陷入危机的得克萨斯石油大亨，则让他尝试另一种角色与表演方式。

谈到影片制作，他强调，这部电影由演员和工作人员亲手完成。拍摄时，他会和同事停下来观察周围的实物布景，欣赏构成这些场景的工艺与技能；创作者获得的本领都来自长期积累。他认为，观众愿意走进影院，正是因为希望看到真实的东西、经历真实的体验。

导演亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊纳里图也在对话中解释，影片独特的喜剧语调无法仅靠剧本写出来，要由演员通过身体与声音寻找。他举例说，片场让众人笑个不停的表演，第二天看素材时却发现并不奏效；改得过于自然，又会失去喜剧效果。他观察到，克鲁斯会仔细处理手放在哪里、何时眨眼、何时沉默等细节，精度如同完成高风险特技时的微小判断。

克鲁斯同时承认，继续进行这些尝试，需要观众买票支持。他希望每部电影的表现都足以给自己下一次创作机会，即使仍有困难，也选择带着快乐去创造。
title_en: Tom Cruise on His Filmmaking Drive: 'Audiences Want Real Experiences'
content_en:
During a post-screening Q&A for the film *Digger* at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, Tom Cruise shared that his drive to keep making movies stems from two things: constantly challenging his past successes and collaborating with his crew to deliver authentic experiences.

In the film, Cruise portrays a Texas oil tycoon facing an environmental crisis—a departure from his action-heavy roles in the *Mission: Impossible* franchise. Cruise emphasized that the film was handcrafted by the cast and crew, noting that audiences flock to theaters because they crave genuine, real-world experiences on screen.

Director Alejandro González Iñárritu praised Cruise's meticulous acting style, comparing his precision in comedy to the split-second decisions made during high-risk stunts. Iñárritu noted that Cruise carefully calculates details like hand placement, blinking, and silence to find the perfect comedic timing.

Cruise acknowledged that continuing these ambitious cinematic endeavors ultimately relies on box-office support. He expressed hope that each project performs well enough to earn him the opportunity to create the next one.

title_zh: 荣耀 Magic9、阶跃 STEPX Neo 获入网许可，智能体手机陆续进入市场
content_zh:
第一财经 9 月 30 日报道，工信部政务服务平台显示，荣耀 Magic9 系列和阶跃终端首款大模型原生智能体手机 STEPX Neo 已获得电信设备进网许可。此前，搭载豆包手机助手的努比亚 NaviX Ultra 于 9 月 1 日获得许可，并于 9 月 16 日发售。

这些产品把 AI 任务执行与手机系统结合：用户提出需求后，由 Agent 调用系统能力及第三方应用，连续完成操作。荣耀通过 MagicOS 11 的系统级 Agent Harness 推进这一方向；阶跃终端则从大模型、操作系统到硬件构建智能体原生手机。

报道提醒，复杂操作的演示成功尚不能证明在不同 App 和真实场景中都能稳定完成任务。入网许可是产品上市前的一项监管程序。
title_en: AI Agent Phones Gain Traction as Honor Magic9 and STEPX Neo Secure Regulatory Approval
content_en:
The Honor Magic9 series and STEPX Neo—the first LLM-native AI Agent smartphone from StepFun—have officially secured network access licenses from China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), Yicai reported on September 30. This follows the launch of the Nubia NaviX Ultra, which features ByteDance's Doubao AI assistant and went on sale on September 16.

These next-generation devices deeply integrate AI task execution with the phone's operating system. Instead of users manually navigating apps, an on-device AI Agent can execute complex, multi-step workflows by calling system capabilities and third-party applications. Honor is driving this integration via its MagicOS 11 system-level "Agent Harness," while STEPX is building its ecosystem from the ground up, spanning the large language model, the OS, and the hardware.

While these advancements mark a significant step forward, industry observers caution that successful stage demonstrations do not guarantee stable performance across diverse, real-world application scenarios. Obtaining the network access license is a key regulatory milestone ahead of the commercial launch.

title_zh: 新一代宝马 3 系亮相：燃油版保留直六，纯电 i3 同步更新
content_zh:
宝马 9 月 30 日发布第八代 3 系。燃油版与纯电 i3 采用相近的新世代外观和 Panoramic iDrive 座舱设计，但动力系统走两条路线：燃油版保留纵置发动机，纯电 i3 使用新世代纯电技术。车内把行驶信息投向挡风玻璃下沿，中控屏尺寸为 17.9 英寸。

两类车型共享设计语言和座舱交互，底层动力架构则按燃油和纯电路线分别开发。

🔗 相关阅读：宝马新一代 3 系亮相！内外全换新，顶配还有 3.0T 六缸
title_en: Next-Gen BMW 3 Series Debuts: ICE Retains Straight-Six as Electric i3 Gets Major Update
content_en:
BMW has officially unveiled the eighth-generation 3 Series, showcasing both the internal combustion engine (ICE) version and the all-electric i3. While both variants share a unified design language and cabin experience, they are built on distinct powertrain architectures tailored to their respective energy sources.

The new lineup features BMW's "Neue Klasse" design aesthetics and the Panoramic iDrive cockpit. Inside, driving information is projected onto the lower edge of the windshield, complemented by a massive 17.9-inch central control screen.

Under the hood, the ICE version retains its longitudinal engine layout, with the top-tier trim continuing to offer a powerful 3.0-liter twin-scroll turbocharged inline-six engine. Meanwhile, the electric i3 leverages BMW's next-generation electric vehicle technology.

title_zh: OpenClaw Enterprise 开放自托管试用，可为企业智能体设定隔离与权限
content_zh:
OpenClaw 发布开源的 OpenClaw Enterprise，为企业持续运行的 AI 智能体提供统一控制层。项目最初由 OpenAI 团队开发，随后捐赠给 OpenClaw Foundation，Red Hat 和英伟达参与协作；官方称，自托管版本将保持免费。

该系统支持多租户隔离、权限管理和操作审计，企业可替换底层模型、智能体执行框架与沙盒，也可接入内部组件。英伟达表示，其开源 OpenShell 可以作为治理和隔离智能体的选项。

官方目前开放代码与部署指引，可用 Docker Compose 本地试用，或通过 Kubernetes 部署到内部环境。项目仍处于 1.0 之前的早期阶段，建议用于内部试点，计划在今年稍后发布 1.0；企业不应将当前版本视为已完成的生产环境方案。

OpenAI 已在内部试用名为 Androidclaw 的智能体，接入代码与工具插件，用于检查构建失败并提交修复 PR。后续数周，项目还计划公布更多安全设计和参考架构。
title_en: OpenClaw Enterprise Launches Self-Hosted Trial for Secure AI Agent Management
content_en:
OpenClaw has released the open-source OpenClaw Enterprise, providing a unified control plane for continuously running enterprise AI agents. Originally developed by OpenAI and subsequently donated to the OpenClaw Foundation, the project features collaboration from Red Hat and NVIDIA. The self-hosted version will remain free.

The platform supports multi-tenant isolation, permission management, and operational auditing. Enterprises can customize the system by replacing underlying models, agent execution frameworks, and sandboxes, or by integrating internal components. NVIDIA noted that its open-source OpenShell can serve as an option for agent governance and isolation.

Currently in its pre-1.0 phase, the project is recommended for internal pilot testing rather than full production environments, with version 1.0 scheduled for release later this year. Code and deployment guides are now available for local trials via Docker Compose or internal deployment via Kubernetes. OpenAI has already been internally testing an agent named "Androidclaw" to detect build failures and submit pull requests.

title_zh: 问界新 M8 预售 38.98 万元起，赛力斯接手操盘与宣发
content_zh:
问界新 M8 于 9 月 30 日开启预售，预售价 38.98 万元起。这是赛力斯与华为调整合作分工后，首款进入预售阶段的问界新车：赛力斯主导品牌营销、渠道零售与服务等工作，华为继续提供智能化技术支持。按研发周期，这台新车仍由此前华为主导的团队完成设计，预售操盘与宣发则已由赛力斯接手。

新车提供五座和六座布局，车长 5190mm、轴距 3105mm，全系采用 800V 架构。车内更新三联屏及后排娱乐屏，底盘加入双腔空气悬架、双阀 CDC 减振器和 ±8° 后轮转向。

🔗 相关阅读：问界新 M8 预售 38.98 万元，自行主导后，赛力斯迎来第一场实战
title_en: AITO New M8 Pre-Sales Start at 389,800 Yuan as Seres Takes Charge of Marketing
content_en:
Pre-sales for the AITO New M8 officially commenced on September 30, with prices starting at 389,800 RMB. This marks the first vehicle launch since Seres and Huawei restructured their partnership. Under the new agreement, Seres leads brand marketing, retail channels, and services, while Huawei continues to provide intelligent technology support.

Although the vehicle was designed by a Huawei-led team during its development cycle, Seres is fully managing the pre-sale operations and promotional campaigns.

The New M8 is available in five- and six-seat configurations, measuring 5,190 mm in length with a 3,105 mm wheelbase. Built on an 800V architecture, the SUV features a triple-screen dashboard, rear-seat entertainment screens, dual-chamber air suspension, dual-valve CDC dampers, and ±8° rear-wheel steering.

title_zh: iCAR V27 长续航版上市，18.98 万元起，倒车辅助将分批推送
content_zh:
奇瑞 iCAR V27 长续航版于 9 月 30 日上市，推出两款四驱车型：猎鹰 500 售 18.98 万元，猎鹰 700 售 20.38 万元。新版本将 CLTC 纯电续航从在售车型的 210 公里提升至 300 公里，综合续航为 1300 公里。

车辆搭载 51.2kWh 增程专用电池，采用宁德时代磷酸铁锂电芯，官方给出的 30%—80% 充电时间为 17 分钟，并支持 6kW 外放电。前排增加零重力座椅、电动腿托和按摩功能，车顶配备双天幕。

同日发布的地平线 HSD V2.1 将于 10 月 8 日起向 iCAR V27 车主分批推送。更新加入全场景倒车 Beta、自定义车位遥控泊入泊出、实体钥匙遥控泊车，以及循迹倒车与泊车辅助衔接等功能。倒车功能仍属于辅助驾驶，且处于 Beta 阶段；发布时间与车主实际收到升级的时间不同。
title_en: Chery Launches iCAR V27 Long Range Edition Starting at 189,800 RMB
content_en:
Chery has officially launched the Long Range edition of its iCAR V27 SUV, offering two four-wheel-drive variants: the Falcon 500 priced at 189,800 RMB and the Falcon 700 at 203,800 RMB. The new edition significantly boosts the CLTC pure electric range from 210 km to 300 km, achieving an impressive comprehensive range of 1,300 km.

The vehicle is equipped with a 51.2 kWh range-extender-specific battery pack utilizing CATL lithium iron phosphate (LFP) cells. It supports 6 kW vehicle-to-load (V2L) power output and can charge from 30% to 80% in just 17 minutes. Interior upgrades include zero-gravity front seats with electric leg rests and massage functions, alongside dual panoramic sunroofs.

On the software front, the Horizon HSD V2.1 system will be rolled out in batches to iCAR V27 owners starting October 8. This update introduces features such as all-scenario reversing (Beta), remote parking via custom parking spaces or physical keys, and seamless transitions between tracking reverse and parking assist.

title_zh: 三星发布 Galaxy Tab S12 系列，Ultra 机身厚 5.1 毫米
content_zh:
三星 9 月 30 日发布 Galaxy Tab S12+ 与 Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra，两款平板均搭载联发科天玑 9500 芯片。Ultra 配备 14.6 英寸 Dynamic AMOLED 2X 屏幕，机身厚度为 5.1 毫米。

新系列采用 Android 17 和 One UI 9，支持同时打开三个区域的多窗口操作，附带 S Pen；另售键盘保护套配有 AI 快捷键，可调用 Bixby、Gemini 或 Perplexity。两款设备均具备 IP68 防尘防水等级。

三星官方数据显示，Ultra 与 S12+ 的视频播放续航分别可达 23 小时和 21 小时。

售价方面，Galaxy Tab S12+ 售价 8899 元起；Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra 售价 10499 元起。
title_en: Samsung Unveils Galaxy Tab S12 Series with Ultra-Thin 5.1mm Ultra Model
content_en:
Samsung has officially unveiled the Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra tablets. Both devices are powered by MediaTek's Dimensity 9500 processor. The flagship Ultra model boasts a massive 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display while maintaining an incredibly slim profile of just 5.1 mm.

The new series runs on Samsung's customized One UI, supporting three-window multitasking and coming bundled with the signature S Pen. Users can also purchase a separate keyboard cover featuring a dedicated AI hotkey to quickly summon Bixby, Google Gemini, or Perplexity. Both tablets carry an IP68 dust and water resistance rating.

In terms of battery life, Samsung claims the Ultra and S12+ can deliver up to 23 and 21 hours of continuous video playback, respectively. Pricing in China starts at 8,899 RMB for the Galaxy Tab S12+ and 10,499 RMB for the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra.

title_zh: B 站开源 Index-Translate，支持 150 种语言并针对社区热梗优化
content_zh:
B 站 9 月 30 日开源 Index-Translate 多语言翻译模型家族，文本翻译支持 150 种语言，提供 2B、9B 及 35B-A3B 预览版模型，基于 Qwen3.5 构建。官方把社区语境、格式约束和长文本一致性列为优化重点。

项目给出的例子中，「狒瘾犯了」被按《最终幻想 XIV》的玩家语境翻译为想玩 FFXIV，而没有照字面理解成对狒狒上瘾。模型也支持保留 JSON、标签和话题格式，减少翻译时破坏结构的问题。这些展示来自项目方示例。

同一模型家族还包括字幕与语音翻译、受音节长度约束的翻译，以及长文档翻译。150 种语言对应文本模型，语音和文档模型各有自己的语言范围；较大参数版本目前仍标为预览版。
title_en: Bilibili Open-Sources Index-Translate: A Multilingual Model Optimized for Internet Slang
content_en:
Bilibili has open-sourced "Index-Translate," a new family of multilingual translation models. Built on the Qwen architecture, the models support text translation across 150 languages and are available in 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B preview versions. The project prioritizes community context, formatting constraints, and long-text consistency.

A key highlight of Index-Translate is its ability to accurately translate internet slang and gaming jargon. For instance, the Chinese gaming meme "狒瘾犯了" (literally "baboon addiction") is correctly translated as a craving to play *Final Fantasy XIV* based on player context, rather than a literal translation. The model also excels at preserving structural formats such as JSON, tags, and hashtags during translation.

Beyond text, the Index-Translate family includes specialized models for subtitle and voice translation, syllable-constrained translation, and long-document processing. While the text model supports 150 languages, the voice and document models have their own specific language coverages, with larger parameter versions currently marked as previews.

title_zh: Ling-3.1-flash 开放体验，强化长任务与代码执行能力
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵 9 月 30 日宣布升级 Ling-3.1-flash，重点面向代码编写、工具调用和多步骤任务。模型采用混合注意力架构，总参数为 560B，激活参数为 25B，并通过强化学习训练提升复杂任务中的持续执行能力。

百灵展示了模型长时间运行编程任务的案例：从头用 C++ 编写 Lua 原生编译器，连续工作约 17 小时，最终通过 182 项测试中的 178 项；团队还用它改写 Pyright，并在 2279 项测试全部通过后测得运行速度提高。这些结果来自百灵自己的演示与测试。

Ling-3.1-flash 已在体验平台开启为期两周的免费试用，免费期提供 256K 上下文。百灵计划在免费期结束后推出付费服务、开放 1M 上下文并开源模型；当前公告中的开源属于后续计划。
title_en: Ant Group's Bailing Upgrades Ling-3.1-Flash with Enhanced Coding and Long-Task Capabilities
content_en:
Ant Group's AI division, Bailing, announced the upgrade of its Ling-3.1-flash model on September 30. The updated model is specifically optimized for code generation, tool invocation, and complex multi-step tasks. Featuring a hybrid attention architecture, the model boasts 560 billion total parameters with 25 billion active parameters, utilizing reinforcement learning to sustain performance during long-running tasks.

To showcase its capabilities, Bailing demonstrated the model executing prolonged programming tasks. In one test, the model worked continuously for approximately 17 hours to write a native Lua compiler in C++ from scratch, successfully passing 178 out of 182 tests. In another demonstration, it rewrote Pyright, passing all 2,279 tests with improved execution speeds.

Ling-3.1-flash is currently available for a two-week free trial, offering a 256K context window. Following the trial, Bailing plans to launch paid services, expand the context window to 1M, and open-source the model.

title_zh: 豆包接入机票、火车票预订，出行服务新增统一入口
content_zh:
豆包官方公众号 9 月 30 日宣布扩展出行服务，用户可在对话中描述行程，查询、比价并预订机票和火车票，也可调用打车与路线导航。应用新设「出行用豆包」入口，汇集地图导航、交通出行、酒店住宿和吃喝玩乐等场景。

机票和火车票服务由航班管家、高铁管家提供，覆盖航班查询、价格比较、在线预订和订单管理；打车服务接入曹操出行等平台，导航与百度地图等平台合作。曹操出行与豆包此前已在部分城市上线 AI 打车，本次新增的重点是把长途交通预订与市内出行放在同一个对话入口。
title_en: ByteDance's Doubao Integrates Flight and Train Bookings into Unified Travel Portal
content_en:
ByteDance's AI assistant, Doubao, announced an expansion of its travel services on September 30. Users can now search, compare prices, and book flights and train tickets directly through conversational prompts, alongside accessing ride-hailing and navigation services. A new dedicated portal, "Travel with Doubao," has been introduced to consolidate map navigation, transit, hotel bookings, and local entertainment.

The flight and train booking services are powered by Flight Manager and High-Speed Railway Manager, enabling comprehensive search, price comparison, online booking, and order management. Ride-hailing is integrated with platforms like Cao Cao Mobility, while navigation is supported by Baidu Maps.

While Doubao and Cao Cao Mobility had previously launched AI-driven ride-hailing in select cities, this update marks a significant step forward by integrating long-distance travel bookings and local urban transit into a single conversational interface.

title_zh: 罗永浩连续追问后，东方甄选宣布溜溜凳双倍退款
content_zh:
东方甄选直播间 9 月 30 日发布声明，回应消费者对「溜溜凳」的质量投诉：凡在其直播间购买该产品的用户，可获相当于货价两倍的退款，且无须退货。此前，交个朋友直播间已对同款产品启动退款，罗永浩连续发文追问东方甄选的处理方式。

东方甄选称，已要求商家再次送检，并自行安排独立检测。由于检测报告需要时间，直播间决定先实行上述退款方案，同时承诺加强商家审核和品控。消费者此前反映凳子内部可能存在发霉木板、废旧海绵等问题；材料是否合格、不同批次产品的实际情况，仍待检测与调查结果厘清。
title_en: East Buy Offers Double Refunds on Defective Stools Following Pressure from Luo Yonghao
content_en:
E-commerce livestreaming platform East Buy announced on September 30 that it will offer double refunds to customers who purchased the "Liuliu Stool" through its channel, without requiring them to return the product. The decision follows quality complaints and persistent public questioning from high-profile influencer Luo Yonghao regarding East Buy's handling of the issue.

Luo's own livestreaming brand, "Make Friends," which sold the same product, had already initiated refunds. In response, East Buy stated it has demanded the manufacturer submit the product for re-testing and is also conducting its own independent investigation.

While awaiting the official test results, East Buy opted to issue the proactive double refunds to protect consumer interests and pledged to tighten its merchant vetting and quality control processes. Consumers had previously complained that the stools contained moldy wood and discarded sponge materials.

title_zh: 国庆相机租赁涨价，部分热门机型提前租空
content_zh:
第一财经记者陈杨园 9 月 30 日走访多个租赁平台和商家发现，国庆期间大疆 Osmo Pocket 4、理光相机多款机型普遍缺货。受访商家称，店内二三十款相机基本已无假期档期，部分热门理光机型从 9 月中旬起就已被租完。

价格也随之上涨。一家商户给出的大疆相机节日租赁报价为每天 80 元；受访消费者称，理光 GR3X 平日每天约 20 元，国庆假期涨至 70 元。上述价格来自具体商家报价与消费者反馈，并非统一市场定价。

租赁需求还延伸至演唱会长焦装备、服装及出游车辆。人人租披露，今年暑期平台短期租用相关订单同比增长 66.8%，95 后、00 后贡献相关类目超过 66.5% 的订单，显示年轻消费者对按需使用设备的需求。

艾媒咨询分析师张毅在采访中指出，节假日与演唱会带来的需求集中释放，也增加了设备调配难度。商家仍要承担采购、维保、定损与物流成本，旺季还可能出现商家失约、押金纠纷等问题。
title_en: Camera Rentals Surge in Price and Demand Ahead of China's National Day Golden Week
content_en:
Demand for camera rentals has skyrocketed ahead of China's National Day holiday, leaving popular models fully booked and driving up rental prices. According to industry reports, popular devices like DJI's Osmo Pocket series and various Ricoh camera models are widely out of stock. Some merchants reported that their entire inventory of dozens of cameras had been fully booked since mid-September.

Rental prices have surged accordingly. For instance, a Ricoh GR3X, which typically rents for around 20 RMB ($2.80) per day, saw its holiday rate jump to 70 RMB ($10) per day. This surge in demand is not limited to cameras; it also extends to telephoto lenses for concerts, outdoor clothing, and travel vehicles.

Data from rental platform Renrenzu shows a 66.8% year-on-year increase in short-term rental orders during the summer, with Gen Z consumers (born after 1995 and 2000) accounting for over 66.5% of the transactions. Analysts note that while the rental economy is booming, peak-season demand spikes present logistical challenges for merchants, who must also navigate risks such as deposit disputes and equipment maintenance.

title_zh: 《Koffee With Karan》宣布告别，播出 22 年后迎来终季
content_zh:
据 Variety 9 月 30 日报道，印度导演、制片人 Karan Johar 宣布结束由他主持的名人访谈节目《Koffee With Karan》。第九季将是最后一季，计划于 10 月 14 日在 JioHotstar 上线。

节目于 2004 年在 Star World 首播，第一集嘉宾是 Shah Rukh Khan 和 Kajol。此后八季共播出 161 集，嘉宾在沙发上聊电影、关系与个人生活，快速问答环节也成为固定招牌。节目 2022 年转为 Disney+ Hotstar 独家流媒体内容，如今平台已并入 JioHotstar。

Johar 表示，告别是一个个人且带有情感的决定，他希望把接下来十年的更多时间留给电影导演工作。他同时掌管 Dharma Productions，长期在导演、制片与电视主持之间切换；这次终季也为持续 22 年的访谈节目划下句点。
title_en: Iconic Indian Talk Show 'Koffee With Karan' to End After 22 Years
content_en:
Renowned Indian filmmaker and host Karan Johar has announced the end of his iconic celebrity talk show, *Koffee With Karan*. The upcoming ninth season, scheduled to premiere on October 14 on JioHotstar, will serve as the series finale, marking the end of the show's 22-year run.

Since its debut in 2004 on Star World with superstars Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol as the inaugural guests, the show has broadcast 161 episodes across eight seasons. It became a cultural phenomenon in India, famous for its candid couch conversations about Bollywood, personal relationships, and its signature rapid-fire segment.

Johar shared that ending the show was a deeply personal and emotional decision, driven by his desire to focus more on film directing over the next decade. In addition to hosting, Johar heads Dharma Productions and has long balanced roles as a director, producer, and television personality.

title_zh: 《星期三》第三季杀青，Eva Green 加入饰演姨妈
content_zh:
Netflix 9 月 30 日公布《星期三》第三季的新剧照，Jenna Ortega 饰演的星期三坐在打字机前；该季已完成拍摄。剧集继续由 Tim Burton 参与制作，拍摄地点包括都柏林和巴黎。

新一季加入 Eva Green，饰演 Morticia 的妹妹、星期三的姨妈 Ophelia Frump。Winona Ryder 也将参演，再次与 Ortega 和 Burton 合作；Catherine Zeta-Jones、Luis Guzmán、Emma Myers 等原班演员回归。

《星期三》于 2022 年上线，把亚当斯一家中的长女带入校园与悬疑故事。第三季将继续扩展家族成员及星期三身边的人物关系。
title_en: 'Wednesday' Season 3 Wraps Filming with Eva Green Joining the Cast
content_en:
Netflix has officially wrapped production on the highly anticipated third season of *Wednesday*. The streaming giant marked the milestone by releasing a new promotional still featuring Jenna Ortega in her titular role. The upcoming season, executive produced by Tim Burton, was filmed on location in Dublin and Paris.

The new season introduces Eva Green to the cast as Ophelia Frump, Morticia Addams' sister and Wednesday's aunt. Winona Ryder is also set to join the ensemble, reuniting with Ortega and Burton. Returning cast members include Catherine Zeta-Jones, Luis Guzmán, and Emma Myers.

Debuting in 2022, *Wednesday* follows the eldest daughter of the Addams Family as she navigates school life and solves supernatural mysteries. Season 3 is expected to further explore the Addams family tree and Wednesday's evolving relationships.

title_zh: 《疾速追杀》第一部定档 10 月 30 日，首次登陆内地院线
content_zh:
基努·里维斯主演的《疾速追杀》第一部定于 10 月 30 日在中国内地上映。猫眼电影 9 月 30 日发布定档物料，确认这是系列开篇之作首次引进内地院线；影片最初于 2014 年推出。

故事从退休杀手约翰·威克的生活被打破开始：妻子病逝后，一只小狗成为留给他的陪伴，黑帮成员却闯入家中、偷走爱车并杀死小狗，迫使他重新拿起武器。

影片由查德·斯塔赫斯基执导、德里克·科尔斯塔德编剧，威廉·达福、伊恩·麦柯肖恩、兰斯·莱迪克等参演。第一部以近身格斗与枪械动作的组合建立了系列的鲜明风格。
title_en: 'John Wick' to Make Mainland China Theatrical Debut on October 30
content_en:
The action-packed thriller *John Wick*, starring Keanu Reeves, is officially scheduled to hit theaters in mainland China on October 30. According to promotional materials released by Maoyan on September 30, this marks the first time the 2014 franchise starter will be shown on mainland Chinese big screens.

The film follows the story of John Wick, a retired legendary assassin who is forced back into the criminal underworld. After his wife passes away, she leaves him a puppy to help him cope with grief. However, when gangsters break into his home, steal his prized car, and kill his beloved dog, Wick unleashes a relentless wave of vengeance against those who wronged him.

Directed by Chad Stahelski and written by Derek Kolstad, the film also stars Willem Dafoe, Ian McShane, and the late Lance Reddick. The original *John Wick* is widely celebrated for establishing the franchise's signature "gun-fu" style, blending close-quarters combat with stylized gunplay.
